title: 天皇賞（秋）の後に・彩たる光集めて今

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ardan emerges triumphant. Impressed, Oguri Cap likens her running to the prismatic shine of a glass ornament.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ardan, Sakura Chiyono O, and Yaeno Muteki are hailed as the new top three by the audience, and share a joyous moment in time together.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ardan sears her vividly colorful light into the fleeting moment, leaving a dazzling trail that will shine on for all eternity.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fully spent after the race, Mejiro Ardan leans on me for support amidst thunderous applause and cheers of her name.
